description: Defines the pucch_resource_manager class for managing PUCCH resources in a cellular network, including resource reservation, release, and slot management, with associated helper classes and data structures.

classes.name: pucch_harq_resource_alloc_record
classes.description: Container for the result of a PUCCH HARQ resource allocation request, including resource pointer and indicator.

classes.name: pucch_resource_manager
classes.description: Manages cell PUCCH resource allocation, reservation, and release for UEs, including slot-based management and resource guards.

classes.name: pucch_resource_manager::ue_reservation_guard
classes.description: RAII helper class for temporary reservation of PUCCH resources for a UE, with commit and rollback capabilities.

methods.name: pucch_resource_manager
methods.description: Constructor initializing the resource manager with cell configuration.

methods.name: slot_indication
methods.description: Resets all resources to 'unused' at a given slot.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the resource manager, likely cleaning up or halting operations.

methods.name: reserve_harq_common_resource
methods.description: Reserves a common PUCCH HARQ resource if available.

methods.name: release_harq_common_resource
methods.description: Releases a previously reserved common PUCCH HARQ resource.

methods.name: ue_reservation_guard::reserve_harq_set_0_resource_next_available
methods.description: Reserves the next available resource in set 0 for HARQ.

methods.name: ue_reservation_guard::reserve_harq_set_1_resource_next_available
methods.description: Reserves the next available resource in set 1 for HARQ.

methods.name: peek_sr_resource
methods.description: Peeks at the UE's SR PUCCH resource without reserving.

methods.name: peek_csi_resource
methods.description: Peeks at the UE's CSI PUCCH resource without reserving.

methods.name: release_harq_set_0_resource
methods.description: Releases HARQ set 0 resource for a UE.

methods.name: release_harq_set_1_resource
methods.description: Releases HARQ set 1 resource for a UE.

methods.name: release_sr_resource
methods.description: Releases SR resource for a UE.

methods.name: release_csi_resource
methods.description: Releases CSI resource for a UE.

methods.name: commit
methods.description: Commits all resource reservations made in the current guard scope.

methods.name: rollback
methods.description: Rolls back all resource reservations made in the current guard scope.
